description: Assigns a TextAnalyzer pair to one column. Maps to OpenSearch's analyzer + search_analyzer on the column's field mapping. Typically the two are the same; supply different analyzers only when index-time and search-time should produce different token streams (e.g. edge n-gram index analyzer paired with a non-ngram search analyzer for autocomplete fields).

columnName.description: The name of the column to override. Silently skipped at index-build time if the column is not present in the target SearchIndex's schema — a single override bundle can therefore be applied across several indexes that share some column names.

indexAnalyzer.description: Qualified name ('{organizationName}-{name}') of the TextAnalyzer to use when INDEXING this column.

searchAnalyzer.description: Qualified name ('{organizationName}-{name}') of the TextAnalyzer to use when SEARCHING this column. Often identical to indexAnalyzer. Use a different qname when search-time analysis should swap to a wholly different analyzer record rather than just a different filter chain inside the same analyzer (the latter is handled by 'searchFilterOrder' inside TextAnalyzerSettings).
